name: Empire Hostess Club
source:
Congratulations! You’ve been hit by a truck!
I’m sure you already know what that means, right? Exactly. You’re about to be sent to an Isekai.
The Goddess sends you to a new world, giving you a second chance, where you will be in charge of running a brothel. You will meet and build bonds with your girls, help them deal with their problems, and gradually build your own harem. But be careful, an ancient evil has just awakened.
You are the protagonist of this story, but the world does not revolve around you. Your girls have a past, with their own problems and relationships. You will have the option to observe, from a third-person perspective, the stories of some of the club’s clients.
translation:
恭喜你！你被大卡车撞飞啦！
相信你肯定已经明白这意味着什么了吧？没错，你马上就要穿越去异世界了。
女神将你送往一个全新的世界，赐予你第二次人生机会，并命你负责经营一家风俗妓院。你将与店里的姑娘们相识结缘、帮她们排忧解难，一步步建立起专属于你的后宫。但请务必当心——一股古老的邪恶力量刚刚苏醒。
你固然是这个故事的主角，但整个世界并非只围着你一个人转。店里的姑娘们各自有着过往经历、烦恼心事与人际纠葛；你还可以选择以第三人称视角，旁观俱乐部部分客人们的故事。
